title: Anthropic appoints Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan to its board, its second board addition in recent months as it eyes an IPO and pushes further into healthcare (Kate Clark/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Kate Clark / Wall Street Journal: Anthropic appoints Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan to its board, its second board addition in recent months as it eyes an IPO and pushes further into healthcare — The startup behind the popular Claude chatbot and coding tool is eyeing a potential IPO as soon as this year
